parameters.query: WITH a AS (UPDATE appointments SET status=$1,updated_at=now() WHERE id=$2 AND status='confirmed' RETURNING id,customer_id,estimated_value), e AS (INSERT INTO attendance_events(appointment_id,outcome,recorded_by,occurred_at) SELECT id,$1,$3,now() FROM a ON CONFLICT(appointment_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING appointment_id), offer AS (INSERT INTO recovery_offers(appointment_id,customer_id,status,not_before,expires_at,estimated_recoverable_value,evidence_type) SELECT a.id,a.customer_id,'scheduled',now()+interval '7 days',now()+interval '14 days',a.estimated_value,'simulated' FROM a JOIN e ON e.appointment_id=a.id WHERE $1='no_show' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM recovery_offers r WHERE r.appointment_id=a.id) RETURNING id) SELECT (SELECT id FROM offer) AS recovery_offer_id;
